descripcion.en:
Toni owes $260 and lives with his mom. Day 3: renting his bedroom to tourists.
What business should he try tomorrow? Comment and he'll do it.

Comedy fiction series. Not financial advice.
#shorts #comedy #animation #money

texto.es: Día 3. Hay un turista alemán desayunando en la cocina, y la madre de Toni no sabe quién es.
texto.en: Day 3. There is a German tourist having breakfast in the kitchen, and Toni's mom has no idea who he is.

texto.es: Todo empezó anoche. Toni debe 260 euros, y ha visto que la gente alquila habitaciones por internet.
texto.en: It all started last night. Toni owes 260 dollars, and he saw that people rent out rooms online.

texto.es: Así que anuncia la suya. Suite de lujo. Treinta euros la noche. Es su cuarto, con el póster de cuando tenía doce años.
texto.en: So he lists his own. Luxury suite. Thirty dollars a night. It is his bedroom, with the poster from when he was twelve.

texto.es: Y alguien reserva. Toni duerme en el sofá, feliz. Ya es empresario hotelero.
texto.en: And someone books it. Toni sleeps on the couch, happy. He is now in the hotel business.

texto.es: Hasta esta mañana. Su madre le ha hecho el desayuno al señor. Y se lo cobra a Toni. Quince euros.
texto.en: Until this morning. His mom made the man breakfast. And she is charging Toni for it. Fifteen dollars.

texto.es: Y otros veinticinco por dormir en su sofá.
texto.en: And another twenty-five for sleeping on her couch.

texto.es: Balance del día 3. Gana treinta, paga cuarenta. Ahora debe 270 euros.
texto.en: Day 3 balance. He makes thirty, he pays forty. Now he owes 270 dollars.

texto.es: ¿Qué negocio prueba mañana? Coméntalo, y Toni lo hace.
texto.en: What business should he try tomorrow? Comment it, and Toni will do it.
